content.title: Build agent-harness Echo v1
content.body: Create a clean-slate Python HTTP/SSE service and Python SDK for CLI-based coding agents under /home/claude/projects/agent-harness-echo. The v1 spine is Session and Run with the agreed /v1 API shape. The defining product constraint is the hybrid orchestrator + observer model: harness-launched runs own lifecycle, while externally-started Claude Code and Codex sessions are discovered from transcript files and surfaced through the same normalized messages and SSE events. Keep v1 single-user, no auth endpoints, no OpenCode, no UI. Keep notes in ~/.agents/echo and coordinate sub-sessions only with agentcom.
